:::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="50%"}
::: {.lit-card}
[46,000]{.lit-num}

[Earthquake spectra from The Geysers, 2012 to 2014, grouped by k-means with no labels. Each of the four clusters peaks once a year, in turn, following the water-injection rate.]{.lit-msg}

[Holtzman, B. K., Paté, A., Paisley, J., Waldhauser, F., & Repetto, D. (2018). Machine learning reveals cyclic changes in seismic source spectra in Geysers geothermal field. *Science Advances*, 4(5), eaao2929.]{.lit-cite}
:::

::: {.lit-card}
[10 → 4]{.lit-num}

[A Gaussian mixture started with 10 clusters on one day of one Greenland station and kept 4. One of them holds the repeating precursors of the 2017 Nuugaatsiaq landslide.]{.lit-msg}

[Seydoux, L., Balestriero, R., Poli, P., de Hoop, M., Campillo, M., & Baraniuk, R. (2020). Clustering earthquake signals and background noises in continuous seismic data with unsupervised deep learning. *Nature Communications*, 11, 3972.]{.lit-cite}
:::
:::

::: {.column width="50%"}
::: {.lit-card}
[43%]{.lit-num}

[K-means on the terms of the barotropic vorticity budget splits the global ocean into five main dynamical regimes. The largest, depth-coherent flow, covers 43% of the ocean area.]{.lit-msg}

[Sonnewald, M., Wunsch, C., & Heimbach, P. (2019). Unsupervised learning reveals geography of global ocean dynamical regions. *Earth and Space Science*, 6(5), 784–794.]{.lit-cite}
:::

::: {.lit-card}
[k ≥ 4]{.lit-num .bad}

[On uniform noise, which has one cluster, all eight elbow-based rules tested pick four or more.]{.lit-msg}

[Schubert, E. (2023). Stop using the elbow criterion for k-means and how to choose the number of clusters instead. *ACM SIGKDD Explorations Newsletter*, 25(1), 36–42.]{.lit-cite}
:::
:::
